People: Horatio Bridge (author, Wikidata Q5902626), died 1893; Nathaniel Hawthorne (editor, Wikidata Q69339), died 1864. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bridge, Horatio, 1806-1893; Hawthorne, Nathaniel, 1804-1864 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Journal of an African cruiser: comprising sketches of the Canaries, the Cape de Verds, Liberia, Madeira, Sierra Leone, and other places of interest on the west coast of Africa, New York, G.P. Putnam & Co., 1853, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/journalofafrican00bridrich. The scan does not show the credit of Horatio Bridge, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
